summary: An announcement that a US Air Force weather center would provide years of surface and upper-air weather observations through the datacomputer. A working group was formed to design the database, plan tests and tackle technical issues, and interested users were invited to join.

plainLanguage.summary: This RFC announces plans to make weather data available through the network datacomputer. A working group would design and test the database and coordinate its development.

questions: what weather data was planned for the network
subtitle: An announcement of weather observations planned for the ARPA Network.

tldr.problem: Researchers needed access to a large collection of surface, upper-air and analyzed weather data.
tldr.mechanism: The U.S. Air Force Environmental Technical Applications Center planned to provide the data through the ARPA Network datacomputer.
tldr.outcome: A working group was formed to design the database, coordinate implementation, plan tests and consider uses.

sections.title: Weather Data Collection
sections.content:
The U.S. Air Force Environmental Technical Applications Center was providing weather data for the ARPA Network. The planned collection included ten years of surface and upper-air observations and hemispheric grid-point analyses.

The observations came from approximately 5,000 surface stations and 1,200 upper-air stations distributed around the world.
sections.plainLanguage: The collection was planned to include ten years of weather observations from thousands of stations worldwide. It would also include hemispheric grid-point analyses.

sections.title: Datacomputer Access
sections.content: The data was to be available through the datacomputer, a specialized ARPA Network node intended to manage shared databases, including large ones. The Computer Corporation of America was developing the datacomputer at the time of the announcement.
sections.plainLanguage: A specialized network computer was being developed to manage shared databases. The weather collection was planned to be one of the databases it served.

sections.title: Database Working Group
sections.content:
A working group had been formed to design the database, coordinate its implementation with datacomputer development, plan testing, project possible uses and address technical issues related to its size and complexity.

The RFC invites prospective users, working members and interested parties to contact Dale H. Stern at CCA.
sections.plainLanguage: A working group would plan the database and its tests. People interested in using or developing it were invited to contact the group.
